description: The generic collector rejects an already supported no-op sequential block.
trigger: Call make_tp_allocation with assertions enabled on a DeciLM block whose attention and FFN configurations both have no_op set, leaving all four corresponding children unset.
expected_behavior: Return no records for a block with no weights or computation, as the existing quantization allocator skips such a block.
actual_behavior: register_submodule ignores None, so the inherited collector encounters an empty child list and asserts. Gemma3MMPool has the same childless fallback if queried directly; separately, traversal of either inspected vision model encounters an explicit unsupported Conv at the front.

verification.description: Traced the constructors and child registration into the new collector; no model loader invokes it at this commit.
verification.limits: Direct collection is the trigger, not normal loading or forward execution.

finding.description: The generic allocation collector still cannot return an empty plan for a no-op decoder block.
finding.trigger: With assertions enabled, directly collect an allocation from a DeciLM TransformerBlock with both attention and FFN marked no_op, assuming the module imports have succeeded.
finding.expected_behavior: Return no records for a block with no child work.
finding.actual_behavior: None children are not registered, so the inherited collector asserts on the empty list before returning. The Module diff only changes its allocator import.
